title: Control-plane daemon skeleton
description: Create the long-running Node daemon with config loading, structured logging, graceful shutdown, and a local-only health endpoint; the CLI talks to it over a unix socket.
acceptance: Daemon starts, reports healthy, and stops cleanly on SIGTERM with in-flight runs recorded as interrupted
Health endpoint binds to loopback only (verified by port scan test)
CLI fw status works against the daemon and falls back to direct DB read when it is down
core_adaptation: Single daemon fwd: owns the writer lock, hosts the pipeline, scheduler, reconciler, API and checks. The CLI becomes a client of it.
